Our Capabilities

Unmatched Scale, Precision, and Innovation

With over 18 years of industry expertise and two self-owned factories, Proud Tek stands as a premier RFID and NFC manufacturer in China. We combine technical precision with creative design to deliver customized solutions that meet the evolving demands of the global market.

We prioritize meticulous craftsmanship, cutting-edge design, and strict quality control to ensure every product stands out in durability, performance, and customer satisfaction.

Comprehensive Manufacturing Excellence

We combine robust infrastructure with specialized R&D to provide one-stop RFID solutions—from concept to mass production.

1. Robust Production Capacity & Advanced Facilities We operate two self-owned factories equipped with 10 automated production lines and over 305 pieces of state-of-the-art equipment. Our production processes have been upgraded to international standards, ensuring efficient, stable, and large-scale manufacturing capabilities to meet diverse and rigorous industry requirements.

2. Continuous Innovation & Custom R&D Our dedicated R&D team brings your concepts to life. We invest 10% of our annual profits into new product development and technology upgrades. We excel in customizing RFID products for specific application environments, antenna requirements, and encapsulation materials. Utilizing high-precision mold tooling, we ensure every product meets exacting standards of shape, durability, and finish.

3. Uncompromising Quality Control We believe in building products that stand the test of time. We implement over 12 distinct inspection procedures throughout the manufacturing process, with defect rates recorded and analyzed daily.
